digest.component_or_area: LLM framework trigger system / code review routing
propositions: Rebar project has measured 13.3% fire-rate on committed high-precision trigger tier and additional 22.0% on noisy tier (concurrency-related tokens), with three corpus bugs triggering only through noisy-tier vocabulary
Project overlay mechanism must support per-key merge of trigger_tokens and applies_to globs for code_review.concurrency in .rebar/criteria_routing.json
Two-layer trigger design (committed + project noisy tier) lacks documentation; docs/llm-framework.md must explain the tiers, measured tradeoff, and provide rebar as worked example
Config-effect test must verify that diffs containing project-tier tokens (e.g. index.lock) fire concurrency overlay under rebar's effective routing but not under committed-only routing
